method: SingleFile save of a live conversation; sidebar/header chrome, the avatar data URI and the four @font-face blocks were dropped. The page's own inlined stylesheet and the message-list subtree are kept verbatim.
knownDeficiencies: External stylesheets are absent: the <head> has no <link> and the CSS has no @import, so any vendor stylesheet (the syntax-highlighting theme most likely lives there) never made it into the capture. The inlined <style> is the app's own CSS-in-JS only.
No rendered code block exists anywhere in the captured DOM (zero ``` fences, zero <pre>), so code-block rebuilds and their colours cannot be validated against this capture.
Message content is minimal (short prose only): no LaTeX, tables, lists, images, blockquotes or long/collapsible messages.
Only the light theme is captured.
